cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Use the Proper Title
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This place card should say 'Chairperson Jo.' Please don't abbreviate the office out of the name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they'll notice the omission. Print 'Chairperson' above 'Jo'; that's the proper order.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no room on this card.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use a larger card. Keep the lettering this size, please. I want the people opposite to read it too.

reason: Replace self-explanation about correcting omissions with the concrete audience A needs to see the title.
